create_bayesian_logistic_regression: create a BayesianLogisticRegression model with prior, posterior distributions and dataset size
run_bayesian_logistic_regression_apply: run the BayesianLogisticRegression apply method to compute ELBO, predictions, accuracy and KL divergence
build_linear_model: build a linear model that computes log probabilities and logits from data and posterior samples
test_bayesian_logistic_regression_predic: test the BayesianLogisticRegression predict method to generate predictions from posterior samples
summarize_bayesian_logistic_regression_c: summarize the BayesianLogisticRegression compute_kl method for analytical or sampling-based KL divergence
